const outline_alpha = await history.fetch(7);
const funcs_alpha = (await history.fetch(9)).alpha_funcs;

let content = f_alpha.content;
let version = f_alpha.version;

const edits = [];

for (const funcName of funcs_alpha) {
  const item = outline_alpha.items.find(i => i.name === funcName);
  if (!item) continue;

  const startLine = item.start_line;
  const endLine = item.end_line;

  let indent = "    ";
  const docstring = `${indent}"""${funcName}."""`;

  let newText;
  if (endLine === startLine) {
    const currentLine = content.split("\n")[startLine - 1];
    const bodyMatch = currentLine.match(/:\s*(.*)$/);
    if (bodyMatch) {
      const body = bodyMatch[1].trim();
      newText = `def ${funcName}:` + "\n" + docstring + "\n" + indent + body;
    } else {
      newText = `def ${funcName}:\n${docstring}`;
    }
    edits.push({ start: startLine, end: endLine, newText, type: "replace" });
  } else {
    edits.push({ line: startLine + 1, text: docstring, type: "insert" });
  }
}

// Apply edits in reverse order
for (let i = edits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
  const edit = edits[i];
  if (edit.type === "replace") {
    content = Edit.replaceLines(content, edit.start, edit.end, edit.newText);
  } else {
    content = Edit.insertAt(content, edit.line, edit.text);
  }
}

const w = await tools.replace_file("alpha.py", content, version);
tell(`Added docstrings to alpha.py functions.`);
finish();
